## Moved from GitHub issues on 2026-10-14

Open GitHub issues of mas-bandwidth/yojimbo, recorded here on 2026-10-14 when roadmaps became the standard for future work (Glenn, 2026-10-14). Each item names its issue; the issue is closed with a pointer here.

### Would you sign the Contributor Assignment Agreement?

Hi, and thank you for contributing to yojimbo over the years. I'm asking contributors to sign a short Contributor Assignment Agreement (CAA). New contributions already require it, and I'd like past contributors to sign it too, so ownership of yojimbo is consolidated and I can keep licensing and maintaining it cleanly.

From: mas-bandwidth/yojimbo issue #306, opened 2026-07-18 by gafferongames; moved here 2026-10-14

### connect handshake carries a schema vocabulary announcement

From the schema message form (schema#530 and its second round, owner rulings 2026-09-05): a table-wire message body rides without its id table when the peer has announced its unit's vocabulary once, reliably, before the first body, and never re-announces for the connection's life.

From: mas-bandwidth/yojimbo issue #344, opened 2026-09-05 by gafferongames; moved here 2026-10-14
